title: Against All Odds
note: mentioned during Along Came Polly and Weird Science eps; mentioned again during summer mailbag ep
plot: Terry Brogan, a cynical former football star, is hired to find Jessie Wyler, the runaway mistress of ruthless LA nightclub owner Jake Wise. But trouble brews when he tracks down and falls in love with the beautiful Jessie on a Mexican island—and Jake dispatches his henchman to bring the lovers back.
